title: Generating Full Length Wikipedia Biographies: The Impact of Gender Bias on the Retrieval-Based Generation of Women Biographies

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the availability of retrieved web evidence and downstream generation quality (measured via ROUGE-L, Entailment, Named Entity Coverage, and human evaluation) on a specifically curated dataset of women's biographies versus a general biography dataset (WikiSum).

Disaggregating generation performance metrics (ROUGE-L) and web evidence overlap on specific geographic subsets of the evaluation dataset (Women in Asia and Women in Africa) to demonstrate compounding systemic gaps for marginalized regions.
